# Synthetic Distinct Queue-Pressure Owner

[Queue-pressure admission must preserve age, priority, cancellation, and
downstream capacity as separate state — support: argument]

The common custody rule comes from the
[shared lifecycle method](../../../chapters/living-book-methodology.qmd#shared-chapter-lifecycle-method).
This fixture owns the narrower decision of whether a queued job may consume a
specific capacity lease without starving older work or hiding cancellation.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  Q["Job, age, priority, and cancellation state"] --> C["Capacity and downstream-pressure snapshot"]
  C --> A{"Lease admissible without starvation?"}
  A -- "no" --> W["Wait, shed, or return a named capacity residual"]
  A -- "yes" --> L["Issue expiring capacity lease"]
  L --> O["Observe service, cancellation, and queue-age effects"]
  O -. "pressure drift" .-> C
```

## Interfaces and ownership boundary

The scheduler owns ordering policy; the resource owner owns physical capacity.
This chapter owns only the joined admission record. It cannot create
capacity, rewrite priority, or treat an empty queue as evidence of fair service.

## Evidence and falsification program

Compare the joined admission rule with FIFO, strict priority, and weighted-fair
queueing under frozen arrival traces. Report useful throughput, tail wait,
starvation, cancellation latency, rejected work, resource cost, and every
unfinished job. Reject the idea if a simpler baseline dominates without
discarding a protected class or hiding overload.

## Codex test plan

| Test | Purpose | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Starvation witness | Inject a sustained high-priority stream and require the protected age bound to remain visible. | planned |
| Cancellation race | Cancel before and after lease issue and require exactly one terminal disposition. | planned |
| Capacity drift | Shrink downstream capacity and require lease expiry or reauthorization. | planned |
| Simpler-baseline challenge | Prefer FIFO or weighted fairness when it preserves the same guarantees at lower cost. | planned |

## Source crosswalk

- `fixture_queueing_primary` defines the synthetic queue state and starvation
  challenge; it supplies no empirical result.
- `fixture_backpressure_reference` motivates the capacity signal; it supplies no
  authority or production claim.

## Handoff

The execution owner receives the exact lease, queue-state digest, expiry,
cancellation rule, and unresolved capacity residual. It must not infer job
correctness, resource sufficiency, or permission beyond that lease.
